title: Does quality on carved-DEFLATE encoder provenance rise with the volume of manufactured data, over four rungs spanning two orders of magnitude?

scope.one_line: One manufactured corpus, one carve size, one model class held fixed across rungs, one seed, four rungs. Grouped by source chunk so no source appears in both train and evaluation.
scope.corpus: Source bytes drawn from public-domain and CC0 content plus synthetic generators, mixed deliberately for content diversity, recorded per fragment. Compressed under every available (implementation, level) configuration.
scope.seed: Single seed, recorded in the artifact. No seed sweep; this is not a variance study.
scope.rungs: Four rungs of manufactured fragments spanning at least two orders of magnitude.
scope.unit: One carved window of fixed size from the middle of one compressed stream.
scope.what_this_does_not_cover: It does not cover encoders absent from this box, notably 7-Zip's deflate, Java's Deflater, Go's flate and the Cloudflare and Windows zlib forks. It does not cover carve sizes other than the one frozen here. It does not establish a buyer, a customer or a deployment. It does not claim the task is unstudied - four non-learned tools exist and are named - only that no open dataset does.

slope.passes_if: paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound of the accuracy-per-decade slope > 0

readings.name: slope
readings.unit: accuracy points per decade of manufactured fragments

arms: TRIVIAL BASELINES, built and measured before any learned number is believed: majority class, label-prior sampling, fragment length and compression-ratio only, a depth-3 tree, and logistic regression. The archived trial killed five candidates on this arm and none of them expected it.
NULL CONTROL: labels shuffled, the identical pipeline retrained. It must fall to chance. If it does not, nothing else in the study means anything.

GROUPED SPLIT as the rival explanation run as an arm: fragments carved from the same source bytes never straddle the train/eval boundary, so content memorisation cannot be mistaken for encoder identification. The archived trial measured that exact leak at 0.4873 collapsing to 0.1531.
THE FREE-DECODER ARM (law L3(i)): recorded explicitly as UNAVAILABLE here, with the reason - re-running the compressor requires the plaintext, which a carved fragment does not contain.
stop_rules: If the slope's 95% lower bound does not exceed zero, the curve is FLAT and that is published as a flat curve and the thesis stops. A flat curve is a real finding and a cheap escape from a bad one.
If the top rung does not beat the best trivial baseline by the preregistered 0.05, the study fails regardless of the slope. A rising curve over a residual a dumb rule already owns is not a result.
If the null control does not fall to chance, the entire pipeline is discarded and no number from it is reported.
If the split is not grouped by source chunk, the study fails however good the numbers are.
A rising slope that fails the margin clause is reported as exactly that, never as a success with a caveat.

thesis.abundance_G1: Any bytes are the corpus. The unlabelled substrate is unbounded and free.
thesis.manufacturer_G2: shape (b), the environment supplies truth free. Compress source bytes under every available (implementation, level) configuration and the label IS the configuration used. Four independent DEFLATE implementations are installed on this box - zlib, zopfli, Intel ISA-L igzip, and libdeflate - each with its own levels. Marginal cost per labelled example is one compression call.
thesis.asymmetry_G2a: The manufacturer knows the exact argv. The student receives a window carved from the MIDDLE of the entropy-coded stream: no header, no stream start, no plaintext. Raw DEFLATE carries no encoder field at all, and the zlib FLEVEL hint is two advisory bits that live only in a header the student does not get.
thesis.why_no_incumbent_applies: Every existing tool needs something the carved fragment does not have. preflate and grittibanzli decode the token stream, which requires the dynamic Huffman tables at the STREAM START. precomp and list-compresslevel.py brute-force by RECOMPRESSING, which requires the PLAINTEXT. Verified first-hand against the preflate-rs README during the archived trial: its fingerprinting stage operates on the decoded token sequence.
thesis.why_it_escapes_law_L3i: Law L3(i) says that where a MACHINE does the labelling, re-run-and-compare is a zero-training decoder no learned model can approach - measured at 0.9857 on SAT solvers. That attack requires re-running the machine on the same input. Here the input is the plaintext, and a carved fragment does not contain it. The free decoder is unavailable by construction.
thesis.why_G4_is_the_reason_to_build: The archived trial's G4 check found FOUR non-learned tools and ZERO machine-learning efforts and ZERO open datasets at any scale. G4 joins two clauses with AND, and the second - no open dataset at target scale - is the one that decides whether there is something to BUILD. The scarce artifact here is the dataset, and it does not exist.
